text:
emily_sales: Fyi: Prospect Meridian asking for a POC with committed capacity. They plan weekend promos with sudden traffic: steady ~280 qps, spikes ~1.5k qps. Mix ~50/50 chat (avg 140 tokens) + embeddings. Need recommended reserved GPUs, autoscale, and a preheat plan.
kai_sre: Which model & region? Any compliance requirements?
noor_eng: Pinned to redwood/llm-7b-quantized in us-east-1. HIPAA concern; they want KMS + audit logs. Peak concurrent sessions roughly 900, steady concurrency ~250.
raj_solution: Pricing ask: clear monthly reserved line + burst credits. They want a preheat option so p99 doesn't tank at campaign start.
kai_sre: Throughput rough: mixed effective ~60 qps/GPU on A100-80. For steady 280 -> reserve 5 GPUs. For 1500 peak -> ~25 GPUs total. So recommend reserve 5 + burst up to 20.
noor_eng: Autoscale knobs: min 5, max 25, scale_up threshold 340 qps, scale_up cooldown 60s, scale_down threshold 220 qps, cooldown 600s. Add fallback routing to llm-7b-q4f16 with a 10% canary on surge.
raj_solution: Preheat estimate: warm common KV prefixes ~140M tokens -> ~2.5-3 GPU-hrs per region. Recommend a 4-6 hour preheat window. Offer as one-time preheat add-on in proposal.
kai_sre: Ops caveat: p99 SLA applies when reserved capacity and KV warmed. Document cross-AZ spread (3 AZs for 5 GPUs) and note cross-region replication doubles preheat cost.
emily_sales: Good. Can we package: 5 reserved GPUs @ M/mo, burst pool up to 20 GPUs billed per-GPU-hour, optional 6 GPU-hr preheat @ P/one-time, Private/KMS addendum for HIPAA? Who will draft the appendix?
noor_eng: I'll draft the engineering appendix with per-node latency table (5/10/18/25), preheat steps, and fallbacks.
kai_sre: I'll write the ops runbook (KV warm checklist, tail-latency alarms, throttle recipe).
raj_solution: I'll convert to pricing lanes (steady month, campaign week, sustained worst-case) and add contract fallback knobs (canary %, rollback thresholds).
emily_sales: Awesome. Ops-bot create ticket and I'll schedule discovery with Meridian for Fri 9am ET.
ops-bot: Created ticket #PR-10021: "Meridian POC 6: sizing appendix + preheat runbook + KMS wording" assigned to noor_eng, kai_sre, raj_solution, due 2026-04-10. :white_check_mark:
emily_sales: Thanks team 44d we'll review the appendix before the call.
